_comment: The followers' contracts away (drafting/away_approved.json; SCHEDULES.md 'Away on contract'): a global per follower, 1 while away, set by the away quest's script (not built yet); 'Have you seen ...?' asked of the clerks only while that one is away; one idle per absentee. Built in an ID block of their own (0x1A00-, merged 0x9200-) once 'live' is true, or with AG_AWAY_BUILD=1 for the recording build. 'live' waits for the away quest.

AGHallClerkDay.AWG: Gone on a contract. Expect him back in a day or two, and hungry.
AGHallClerkDay.AWY: Out on a hunt. The best-paid one on the board, knowing her.
AGHallClerkDay.AWZ: Scouting. He'll turn up when he's found something to sell us.

AGHallClerkEvening.AWG: On a contract! The hall's ever so quiet without him.
AGHallClerkEvening.AWY: She's hunting. I'd have given anything to go with her.
AGHallClerkEvening.AWZ: Out scouting! He promised me a story when he's back.

AGHallClerkEvening.text: I hope Ylva's hunt is going well.

AGHallBarkeeper.text: Zhasim's stool is empty. He must be on the road.

AGHallServer.text: Finally some peace and quiet while our resident orc is away.
